correctness.rationale: At depth 0, fixed marker valuations Z(X)=[|X|=0], A(X)=[|X|=1] yield exactly sizes 0,1,>1. For a depth-d child size cutoff t=2^d, exact finite child cardinalities i,j<=t can cover X iff max(i,j)<=|X|<=i+j. If |X|>2t, including infinite cardinality, attainable child-type pairs are uniformly those with >=1 tail child (choose that component X) and impossible for two exact children. Thus formula truth depends solely on sizes 0..2t or >2t at depth d+1. Conversely the join of exact t and k-t cardinality formulas defines [t,k], and subtracting exact lower sizes inductively defines each size k=t+1,...,2t at depth d+1. Hence all 2^d+2 types and arbitrary Boolean unions are realized, yielding 2^(2^d+2) classes, including arbitrary infinite ambient sets. Direct independent cardinality signature refinement for sizes 0..69 at d=0..5 gave 3,4,6,10,18,34 as predicted. The least depth separating 1<=n<m is ceil(log2 n).
